title: Demonic Knight Forging
description: A horned demonic knight in ornate red armor kneels inside a ruined gothic cathedral, hammering a glowing molten sword on an anvil. Blue and red fiery wings spread behind him as light streams from a large rose window above, illuminating ritual circles, an open spellbook, and scattered blood on the stone floor.
prompt: A horned demonic knight in ornate red armor and glowing orange eyes kneels in a ruined gothic cathedral, hammering a molten glowing sword on an anvil with fiery sparks. He has large demonic wings that are blue and red with fire effects. Beams of light shine down from a large intricate rose window above. On the floor are glowing blue and red ritual circles, an open ancient spellbook on a stand, blood splatters and handprints. Dark atmospheric fantasy style with dramatic lighting.
